page_title: PAL 0-1 RAY | Las Palmas v Rayo Vallecano 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Although Francisco (Rayo Vallecano) is just on the bench, Javier Iglesias Villanueva has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+5' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Javier Iglesias Villanueva didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+4' RED CARD! Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Javier Iglesias Villanueva. He can have an early bath.
90+1' 0 - 1 Goal! Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alvaro Valles into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+1' The foul by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Javier Iglesias Villanueva.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. No point in arguing there. Rayo Vallecano will take a penalty kick.
89' Francisco has decided to substitute Alvaro Garcia and he is replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
86' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Javier Iglesias Villanueva ignores the protests.
83' It's time for a substitution. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) comes on in place of Marc Cardona.
83' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Las Palmas will take a free kick.
79' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows the yellow card to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
77' The substitution is prepared. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Isi Palazon.
77' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Munir El Haddadi is replaced by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
74' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
73' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
73' The attendance is 24548.

72' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Iglesias Villanueva no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Las Palmas, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
68' The referee blows his whistle as Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge. Las Palmas get a free kick.
67' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
67' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) makes a strong challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
66' Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Raul de Tomas.
66' Substitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pathe Ciss.
65' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' Substitution. Pejino is replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
62' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Enzo Loiodice will be replaced by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas).
62' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
60' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick.
59' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
56' Corner kick. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to send the ball into the box.
55' Pejino (Las Palmas) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
54' The resulting corner from Pejino (Las Palmas) is cleared.
53' Pejino (Las Palmas) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
52' Kirian (Las Palmas) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
50' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
48' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
48' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a lofted pass but can only head straight at Alvaro Valles, who fumbles and makes the save at the second attempt.
46' Half-time substitution. Saul Coco (Las Palmas) is replaced by Julian Araujo.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Francisco gives a chance to Jorge de Frutos and Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is off.
46' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Alvaro Valles comes off his line to intercept the corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
40' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and makes a call.
40' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
39' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

34' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Stole Dimitrievski anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
33' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
33' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Las Palmas.
31' CHANCE! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
31' A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano. Saul Coco (Las Palmas) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul.

29' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
28' Pejino (Las Palmas) will deliver the corner kick.
27' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Las Palmas force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
22' The linesman signals that Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
20' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) sees a yellow card from Javier Iglesias Villanueva after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
19' A lofted cross from Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

18' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
17' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) touches the ball with his hand. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.

16' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
15' What a shot! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the left post.
15' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
14' A pass from Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Alvaro Valles and the move breaks down.
14' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Pejino (Las Palmas) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Stole Dimitrievski.
10' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) takes the corner with a short pass.
8' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Saul Coco (Las Palmas). It wasn't such a big threat for him.

4' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Stole Dimitrievski displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
4' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
3' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball from a long-range free kick. His shot only flies miles away of the right post. What a poor kick!

2' It looks like Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) saw red with that tackle. Javier Iglesias Villanueva won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
